documents_scope.name: documents_scope
documents_scope.value: "documents"."company_id" is not null or "documents"."opportunity_id" is not null

documents_certificate.name: documents_certificate
documents_certificate.value: "documents"."kind" <> 'company_certificate' or ("documents"."company_id" is not null and "documents"."certificate" is not null)

documents_private_key.name: documents_private_key
documents_private_key.value: "documents"."company_id" is null or "documents"."storage_key" is null or "documents"."storage_key" like 'companies/' || "documents"."company_id"::text || '/%'

documents_public_key.name: documents_public_key
documents_public_key.value: "documents"."company_id" is not null or "documents"."storage_key" is null or "documents"."storage_key" like 'public/%'

search_profiles_value_range.name: search_profiles_value_range
search_profiles_value_range.value: "search_profiles"."min_value" is null or "search_profiles"."max_value" is null or "search_profiles"."min_value" <= "search_profiles"."max_value"
